copy: Machine vision with AI inspects 100% of cans in line to ensure airtightness, avoid claims and protect your reputation. Double-seam inspection detects defects that can compromise airtightness, with decisions in real time: false seams, droops, OCR reading and dents in the can. AIS REV 360 COMPACT provides full 360° double-seam analysis, detects micrometre-scale defects and works without reducing production speed, with traceability and reports for continuous improvement from the first container. Send us samples.
